Can you send us that troubleshooting information and paste it into our input field?


The mf-505: Sender Policy - Relay Denied error in Mozilla Thunderbird means the outgoing SMTP server is rejecting your message because your login credentials do not match your sender address, authentication is turned off, or you are using the wrong mail server for your network


How to Copy Troubleshooting DataClick the menu button (three horizontal lines ≡) in the top right corner of Thunderbird.Select Help, then click Troubleshooting Information.Find and click the button labeled Copy text to clipboard.
